faqs.question: How long does a kitchen remodel take?
faqs.answer: Most kitchens take four to eight weeks of work once materials arrive. We give you a written schedule with the quote.

faqs.question: Can we keep using the kitchen during the work?
faqs.answer: Usually not for the whole job. We set up a temporary sink and counter area when we can, and plan the noisy work in blocks.

faqs.question: Do you handle permits?
faqs.answer: Yes. We pull the permits and schedule the inspections as part of the job.
